```yamlfile
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ['main']
    tags: [v*]
  pull_request:
    branches: ['**']

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  java:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: "! contains(toJSON(github.event.commits.*.message), '[skip ci]')"

    steps:

    - name: 1. Check out code
      uses: actions/checkout@v5
      with:
        fetch-depth: '0'

    - name: 2. Set up Java for running Gradle build
      uses: actions/setup-java@v5
      with:
        distribution: 'zulu'
        java-version: 17
        cache: 'gradle'

    - name: 6. Build on Java 11 with mock-maker-subclass and member-accessor-reflection
      run: >
        ./gradlew
        -Pmockito.test.java=11
        build
        --stacktrace
        --scan
      env:
        MOCK_MAKER: mock-maker-subclass
        MEMBER_ACCESSOR: member-accessor-reflection
```
